request:
SYNTHETIC PLANWORK RECOVERY FIXTURE. Produce a four-milestone engineering plan for the fictional Aster Charts compare-and-swap import and its shared iOS/macOS coordinator. The downstream engineer uses the plan as a four-item implementation checklist and a four-item acceptance checklist. Keep each group a single compact string with substantial implementation or verification detail. Exact schema and assertion examples are more useful than general prose.

Change groups, each as a single string. Include executable-style pseudocode or typed data examples for each named function or state. Keep each group around 550–750 characters.
M1 PARSE/PREVIEW: outline normalizeDashboard, canonicalUid, validatePanels, resolvePlaceholdersAtRender and buildPreview. Specify DashboardDraft and PreviewSnapshot fields, stable payload fingerprint, read-only storage boundary, validation error paths, and identical fixture normalization on both platforms. Include examples for two canonical UIDs, a duplicate panel and both an unresolved and resolved datasource.
M2 COMMIT/RECEIPTS: outline confirmImport, findCommittedReceipt, compareAndSwap, appendActivity, and writeReceipt in transaction order, including cancellation and mismatched replay checks. Distinguish a repeated matching request, a repeated mismatched fingerprint and a new stale revision. Define receipt record fields including schemaVersion, requestId, fingerprint, revisionBefore, revisionAfter, canonicalUid and activityId. Name success and conflict results.
M3 UI/FAILURE: outline an import coordinator state machine and transition guard pseudocode. Include Idle, ValidationFailed, PreviewReady, Submitting, StalePreview, StoreUnavailable, Committed, and Cancelled, and the legal refresh, confirm, retry, and close transitions. Explain what gets wiped by cancel/stale and what can survive an interrupted response. Show how both shells reuse the state reducer and presentation message codes.
M4 ROLLOUT/OBSERVABILITY: outline validation-only tracing, opt-in shared coordinator rollout and fallback to preview only. Include labeled events invalidInput, staleRevision, duplicateReplay, mismatchedReplay, transactionRollback and acceptedCommit; define count semantics and privacy constraints. Specify migration order, receipt version compatibility, verifying iOS/macOS parity, and kill switch/rollback behavior with old receipts kept readable.

Verification groups, each as a single string with a compact table-like series of concrete assertions. Keep each group around 600–800 characters. Every assertion includes the caller observation plus a storage postcondition. Use the following initial state unless a scenario explicitly says otherwise: R4, no dashboard alpha, no activity and no receipt.
T1 READ-ONLY / NORMALIZATION: list five distinct named vectors T1a trimmed ' ALPHA ', T1b canonical alpha with preserved mixed-case title, T1c two same-named panels, T1d unsupported schemaVersion 99 and empty title, T1e unresolved edge-metrics with preview cancel. State exact UID or error code, expected visible fields or error paths, and explicit R4/0 activity/0 receipts. Run parity in iOS and macOS.
T2 AUTHORIZED ATOMIC COMMIT: list T2a SYN101 confirmed at R4, T2b retry SYN101 after response loss, T2c SYN101 reused with changed panel fingerprint, T2d SYN102 on stale R4 after SYN101, T2e SYN103 after fresh preview at R5. Give assertion statements with exact returned/requested revisions, UI codes, canonical UID, activity count and receipt IDs at each step. Confirm old receipts distinguish revisions.
T3 RACE / ROLLBACK: list T3a concurrent distinct SYN111/SYN112 both at R4, T3b concurrent repeated SYN111 after one success, T3c fail at dashboard insert, T3d fail at activity append, T3e fail at receipt persist and then successfully retry same ID. Each rollback subcase resets to R4. Specify the resulting tuple (revision,dashboardPresent,activities,receipts) and relevant typed result. Point out how a deterministic barrier starts both contenders without changing transaction semantics.
T4 UX / OPERATIONS: list T4a cancel read-only preview in iOS, T4b cancel in macOS, T4c concurrent R5 makes R4 preview stale then refresh, T4d persistent datasource placeholder resolves only through current catalog, T4e rollout disabled after an earlier committed receipt. Specify operator symptom, reducer state, permitted actions, storage and metric checks, and earlier receipt accessibility. Include an independent test confirming telemetry exposes no dashboard titles.

Use a brief goal and gaps. Keep citations to the exact identifiers box/charts:README.md and box/native-apple:README.md. Set issueTemplate and issueBody to null. Return complete JSON within the configured cap, targeting 1,250–1,550 output tokens. Include named subcases and assertions ahead of discretionary explanation.
